title.en: Parse a food bank's SMS day: offer, claim, handover with a partial rejection

goal.en: The Humanitarian Profile's SMS grammar lets a program run on basic phones. Parse the three messages of a typical rescue and see the cold-chain checks the gateway applies before it writes a document.

note.en: A supermarket offers 36 kg of yogurt, chilled, at 4 °C, use by 5 November.
The same yogurt declared ambient: the gateway infers the food class from the words and refuses to list it.
A food bank claims the whole offer.
At handover 30 kg are accepted and 6 kg rejected for damaged packaging, measured at 4.6 °C. The reason code maps to the profile's enum.
Arabic-Indic digits are accepted wherever a digit is, so a phone set to an Arabic keyboard works.

cli: cookwala sms "HAND A7K 30 REJ 6 PACK T4.6"

outcome.en: You can turn messages into structured commands and know which ones a gateway refuses. Next: scenario 003 checks a whole flow against a rule pack.
